system.description:
Wind Release: Wind Rider · cast at A-Rank to S-Rank · no type

30 ft flying speed (you no longer need to descend).

You take no falling damage and can't be knocked Prone.

When you Dash, +60 fly speed until the end of the turn.
system.summary: 30 ft flying speed (you no longer need to descend). You take no falling damage and can't be knocked Prone. When you Dash, +60 fly speed until the end of the turn.

rules.text: You have a 30-foot flying speed; you no longer need to end within 1 foot of the ground.
You can't take falling damage or be knocked Prone, and always float at least 1 foot off the ground.
When you take the Dash action, +60 fly speed until the end of the current turn.
